title: Dynamic SQL executed from text (plpgsql) — review required
description: A plpgsql routine executes a statement built as text. If any part of that text is untrusted input, the statement structure is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the execution; the reviewer confirms the text is constant or parameterized.
remediation: Use USING placeholders in EXECUTE, and keep input out of the statement text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.

tests.line: EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id;
# audit: EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id; present
EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1' USING v_id;
# verified: EXECUTE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1' USING v_id;
